Information:
| The Population Density Scalar can be used to increase or decrease average population densities over time in settlements (built-up areas).
 | 
 | Urban and rural populations are not uniformly defined globally; similarly, in land use categorization, settlements (built-up areas) can be defined in terms of building density. For example, farmhouses of agricultural dwellings may be classified under cropland. 
 | 
 | SISEPUEDE therefore estimates land use change demands for settlements using changes to the urban population. Furthermore, as rural populations may not live in built-up areas, changes to rural population do not affect demands for settlements.
 | 
 |Note that, by default, settlements **are not** subject to the land use reallocation factor. They can be subject to the LURF using the `force_lurf_for_settlements` keyword argument.
